$comment: DETERMINISTIC guardrails for the lab. Anything that must happen without fail goes here, not in CLAUDE.md (a prompted instruction can be ignored under pressure; a hook cannot). Hooks are plain Python (no jq): this project runs on Windows, where jq is absent by default. guard_write.py is fail-closed, format_python.py is fail-open.

hooks.command: command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 && uv sync --extra dev --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
